fields.description: Base URL of the candidate frontend used to build campus registration links (e.g. https://portal.example.com). Leave blank to use this site's URL.
fields.label: Candidate Portal URL

fields.description: Sent to every candidate's Email ID when a Candidate Registration is submitted.
fields.label: Candidate Registration Email Template

fields.description: Sent to each TPO on Campus Invite submit, carrying their set-password / login link. Jinja vars: tpo_name, link, login_url, email.
fields.label: TPO Set Password Email Template

fields.description: Emailed to an institute's Primary TPO when the institute is created — and to a Primary TPO added later. Once per contact. Jinja vars: tpo_name, email, role, institute, city, state, tier, login_url.
fields.label: Send TPO Welcome Email

fields.description: Emailed to every TPO contact of the invited institutes when a Campus Invite is submitted. The Primary TPO's set-password email is separate. Jinja vars: invite, region, institute_list, opening_list, openings, login_url.
fields.label: Send Campus Invite Email

fields.description: Off by default: a drive moves hundreds of students through several rounds in a day, and the per-stage note meant for a lateral candidate becomes an email after every round. Tick to email campus candidates on each stage change (still only for stages whose Notify box is ticked on the opening). Lateral candidates are unaffected either way.
fields.label: Notify Campus Candidates on Stage Change
